_note: Build-time tokens for THIS project. Replaced before the MJML compile by tools/build-mail.mjs. Runtime %field% placeholders are NOT listed here and must never be replaced - submit.php fills those on every send. Adapted from the starter's _tokens.json; the differences are recorded under _diverges_from_starter below.

_diverges_from_starter.design: This project's email is not the starter's card+dark-band design. It is a light frame around a white card with a lime accent rule, a CTA button and a quoted-message block, none of which the starter has. Only the BUILD is shared, not the layout - so do not diff the .mjml against the starter's, only the pipeline around them.
_diverges_from_starter.no_dark_band: BRAND_DARK / BRAND_DARK_MUTED / BRAND_DARK_RULE / BRAND_RADIUS / BRAND_RADIUS_INNER do not exist here. There is no dark footer band and no rounded card.
_diverges_from_starter.extra_colours: BRAND_RULE (footer column top border) and BRAND_CREDIT (the credit line and its link) have no starter equivalent.
_diverges_from_starter.display_variants: CLIENT_EMAIL_DISPLAY and CLIENT_PHONE_DISPLAY are derived in tools/build-mail.mjs, not listed here - see CLIENT_EMAIL below.

_kicker_note: %kicker% replaced the older bare %date%. submit.php's build_kicker() joins the form-type field, the date and the language code with a middle dot, dropping whichever do not apply. It renders in the date-text slot at the top right of the notification; the reply gets the date alone.

CLIENT_URL.note: Site root. Also the CTA button's destination in the reply.

CLIENT_LOGO_URL.note: Unlike the starter, this project ships a real logo image rather than a text wordmark. Must be publicly reachable - it lives under starter/assets/images/mail/, never under starter/app/templates/, which is .htaccess-locked and unreachable by mail clients.

CLIENT_EMAIL.note: The href uses this value; the visible text uses CLIENT_EMAIL_DISPLAY, derived from it in build-mail.mjs by inserting zero-width non-joiners at the @ and the final dot. That stops Gmail auto-detecting the address and recolouring it, which it does regardless of inline anchor styles. Do not hand-write the display form.

CLIENT_PHONE.note: Display form, with spaces. CLIENT_PHONE_RAW (tel: href) and CLIENT_PHONE_DISPLAY (zero-width non-joiners between groups, same Gmail reason as the email) are both derived from it. Do not ask for the same number twice.

CLIENT_MAP_URL.note: Unwrap the address to plain text rather than leaving a link to nowhere if this is absent.

CLIENT_INSTAGRAM.note: Delete the whole <a> and its separator if the client has no account - an empty href is worse than no link.

BRAND_FONT.note: Email-safe stacks only. No web fonts - most clients strip external font loading.

BRAND_FONT_HEADING.note: Headings only. Georgia here, against the sans body.

BRAND_ACCENT.note: The lime rule under the logo, the message-quote's left border, and the urgent link's underline. Small elements only - it is far too bright to carry text.

BRAND_INK.note: Body copy, headings, the CTA button's fill.

BRAND_MUTED.note: Field labels, the kicker date, footer copy.

BRAND_FRAME.note: The warm ground the card sits on. Also the field-divider hairline and the message-quote fill, which is why there is no separate BRAND_TINT.

BRAND_RULE.note: The footer column's top border. No starter equivalent.

BRAND_CREDIT.note: The credit line and its link - deliberately lighter than BRAND_MUTED, so the Plura credit sits below the client's own footer in the hierarchy. No starter equivalent.
